tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, within the specified gray zone, but does not cross the reported critical range of 2.50–2.68. High-gradient observations are needed to identify or reject an avalanche downturn.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot gradients are below the stated critical range, so the threshold and avalanche strength are not identifiable.
The pilot’s concave response does not distinguish these smooth alternatives from a threshold mechanism.
A targeted high-gradient probe more directly tests the disputed threshold at lower cost.
